newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent hits nine-month low on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent hits nine-month low on technical selling.

text.p: May Brent on the IPE saw some technical selling push prices below two main support levels to hit the lowest level on the spot continuation chart since last June, as traders liquidated their positions in relatively thin volumes.
May Brent lost some 56 cents to trade at the intraday low of $18.55 a barrel by 1838 GMT, the weakest since $18.46 on June 27 for the nearby futures contract.

"It (May Brent) broke through the previous low of $18.90 and saw some good sell stops coming in. Then it took out the $18.68 (low for 1997 on a continuation basis). The pressure is mainly from the (NYMEX) gasoline," one broker said.
Fundamental weakness was also putting extra pressure on Brent crude with a physical cargo of Brent trading on Wednesday at a 97-cent discount to May Brent.
May WTI crude, where the $20 support level held for much of Brents downward move, traded last down 32 cents at $19.96 a barrel.
